cards.public_summary: Roschon Johnson has received expanded playing time while Kyle Monangai remains sidelined with a knee injury, Larry Mayer reported.
cards.evidence:
With running back Kyle Monangai sidelined due to a knee injury he sustained Aug. 16 in practice, Roschon Johnson has made the most of expanded playing time.
